prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Houston, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1134; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim file purposes. Do you understand and agree to that?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state the location where the collision happened.

A: It was on a main road in Houston, Texas, near a shopping center. I was stopped at a red light when it happened.

Q: Can you describe what happened just before the impact?

A: I was waiting for the light to change. I had my foot on the brake and I was fully stopped. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind and my car was pushed forward into the intersection a little.

Q: Were you the only occupant of your vehicle?

A: Yes, I was alone in the car.

Q: Did the other driver stop at the scene?

A: Yes, they pulled over and we exchanged insurance information. They seemed shaken up too.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day. They said I have whiplash. My neck is stiff and sore, and I get headaches when I turn my head quickly.

Q: Are you currently under a doctor's care or receiving any treatment?

A: I have a follow-up appointment scheduled, and I've been doing some physical therapy exercises at home that the clinic recommended.

Q: Have you missed any time from work because of your injuries?

A: I took a couple of days off to rest, and I'm working with some limitations now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the collision or your injuries?

A: Not right now. I'm just hoping to get my car repaired and my neck back to normal.

Q: Thank you. That concludes our recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
